frame: x east, y north, z up, origin at the shared trace vertex
rake: Aki-Richards: 0 left-lateral, 90 reverse, 180 right-lateral; fixed per element by the tensor
tensor: most compressive axis horizontal at azimuth theta; r = 0 thrust, r = 1 strike-slip, diag(-1, r, 1 - r) between, unit maximum shear
